Devin Booker is an NBA basketball player for the Phoenix Suns.
The Phoenix Suns' record is 16 wins.
The Phoenix Suns' record is 17 losses.
The Oklahoma City Thunder's record is 18 wins.
The Oklahoma City Thunder's record is 16 losses.
Devin Booker was selected by the Suns in the first round of the 2015 NBA draft with the 13th overall pick.
Devin Booker debuted with the Suns at 18 years old.
Kevin Durant returned from a six-game absence due to an ankle sprain and put up a season-high 44 points in 40 minutes.
Devin Booker scored a then-season-high 21 points in a 142–119 loss to the Sacramento Kings.
Devin Booker scored 32 points in a 97–94 loss to the Indiana Pacers, setting a Suns' rookie record with six three-pointers.
Devin Booker became the third-youngest player in NBA history at 19 years, 81 days old to record a 30-point game.
Devin Booker participated for Team USA in the 2016 Rising Stars Challenge.
Devin Booker was named to the U.S. Team for the 2017 Rising Stars Challenge.
Devin Booker became the youngest player to score over 60 points in a game, finishing with a Suns franchise record 70 against the Boston Celtics.
Devin Booker scored a then-career-high 34 points in a loss to the Miami Heat.
Devin Booker recorded a career-high 35 points in a loss to the Denver Nuggets.
Throughout the month of March, Devin Booker led all rookies in points (22.4) and assists (4.9) per game.
Devin Booker reached 1,014 for the season, making him the fourth-youngest player to reach 1,000 career points.
Devin Booker finished fourth in the 2016 NBA Rookie of the Year Award voting.
Devin Booker was named to the All-Rookie First Team.
Devin Booker scored a then-career-high 39 points and at 21 years, 123 days old, he became the third-youngest player in NBA history to reach 4,000 career points.
Devin Booker missed the Suns' final 12 games of the season with a right hand sprain.
Devin Booker signed a five-year, $158 million maximum contract extension with the Suns on July 7, 2018.
Devin Booker was ruled out for six weeks after undergoing surgery to repair the fifth metacarpophalangeal joint in his right hand.
Devin Booker recovered in time for the Suns' season opener on October 17, scoring 35 points in a 121–100 victory over the Dallas Mavericks.
Devin Booker was named an All-Star on February 13, 2020 as an injury replacement after Damian Lillard suffered an groin strain injury.
Devin Booker won the Three-Point Contest over Klay Thompson and Tobias Harris in the final round.
Devin Booker scored a season-high 49 points in a 140–130 road victory over the Denver Nuggets, becoming the fourth-youngest player in NBA history to score 11,000 points.
Devin Booker was named Western Conference Player of the Month for the third time in his career.
Devin Booker scored 52 points and at 28 years, 36 days old, he became the youngest player in NBA history with back-to-back 40+ point games in a row.
Devin Booker was named to the All-NBA Third Team due to his performance in the 2019–20 season.
Devin Booker is the son of Melvin Booker and Veronica Gutiérrez.
Veronica Gutiérrez, Devin Booker's mother, is a cosmetologist.
Melvin Booker, Devin Booker's father, was named the 1994 Big Eight Player of the Year while a point guard at Missouri.
Devin Booker has his own charitable foundation called the Starting Five.
The Starting Five grants five nonprofit organizations $100,000 each.
Devin Booker bought a 5,590 square foot house in Paradise Valley, Arizona for $3.5 million.
Devin Booker was named a global ambassador to the Special Olympics for his support of his younger half-sister who has microdeletion syndrome.
Devin Booker is a Michigan native and a Detroit sports fan.
Devin Booker played on the 2016 USA Select Team that trained against the 2016 U.S. Olympic team.
Devin Booker was named a finalist to play on the 2020 Olympic team.
Devin Booker and Team USA won the Olympic gold medal in men's basketball in 2021.
Devin Booker played a crucial role on Team USA leading up to their gold medal win on August 10, 2021.
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III added Devin Booker as a playable operator for Warzone.
